ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Business & Government: Literacy and Practice in Library and Information Science] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis; contact Kathy Painter (painter@illinois.edu). Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Meets January 21-March 11. Required on-campus session Friday, February 28. See section description for 590BG at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog. 2 GR hours. Instructor: Erwin Cruz, W. W. Grainger (the company, not the Engineering Library)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Lib & Inf Sci Online-UIUC.
